rules.rule: Never commit or merge anything directly into main.
rules.details: All work goes into dev first (via feature branches). main is only updated by merging dev into main.

rules.rule: Merge flow is always: feature branch -> dev -> main.
Do not add AI co-author or co-contributor attribution to commits or pull requests.
Every feature branch must update the test cases.
rules.details: Fix tests broken by the change and add tests for any new behaviour before the branch is merged into dev.
